title: Server: fill error descriptions; don't report an invalid Commit as notAllowed (clean-room C5)
description: Clean-room C5: KeyPackage/set refusals had no description (lifetime too long); a malformed external_pub came back as 'not a valid group'; an invalid Commit came back as notAllowed with empty errorDescription although the hub log said 'the commit is not valid'. Fill description/errorDescription with which check failed everywhere; keep notAllowed for policy refusals and use a distinct, documented result for MLS-invalid commits. Mark 2026-11-21.
